plugins.label: Tournament Access
plugins.description: Closes a tournament server to everyone not on the roster the tournament hub writes into the server's Redis: once the hub enforces it, others are kicked as they load and casters stay in spectator. The server owner and players at the bypass permission level are never checked.

plugins.label: Chat RCON
plugins.description: Lets referees run the Referee-Allowed Commands and admins anything but the Admin-Denied Commands from chat with !rcon <command>. Takes over the stock !rcon while enabled, and every use is written to the server log.

plugins.label: Lobby
plugins.description: For a lobby server: tells each player which game server to join and shows its /connect address after a short countdown, since a server cannot move a player itself. The destination comes from a referee's personal route, a tournament assignment from the hub, or the default destination.

plugins.label: Match Restore
plugins.description: Saves the state of a running match (players, items, timers and the match clock) and puts it back later, or restores a moment from a recorded .qlmatch pack, with the admin command !restore. Needs the minqlxtended runtime and the restore/ folder, which downloads with it.

plugins.label: match_restore helper
plugins.description: Helper of match_restore.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Telemetry (Unified)
plugins.description: Sends live match data (positions, stats, item pickups, match events) from this instance to ql-stats-hub through the host's telemetry relay. Switch it on with the instance's Telemetry entry (telemetry-relay addon), which reserves the server ID; each feed is a separate switch below.

plugins.label: stream_telemetry_unified helper
plugins.description: Helper of stream_telemetry_unified.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: stream_telemetry_unified helper
plugins.description: Helper of stream_telemetry_unified.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Referee Call
plugins.description: Adds !call, which lets any player or spectator ask for a referee, once per 60 seconds. The call reaches the referees through stream_telemetry_unified, which needs Session Events (qlx_statsHubFeedSession) on.

plugins.label: QLMatch Packer
plugins.description: Builds a .qlmatch pack and its .replay.json.gz when the engine finishes a match's demos, by running the qlmatch-packer addon's pack.mjs. Needs the qlmatch-packer addon and the minqlxtended fork with native demo capture, sv_demoRecord 1 and sv_demoCut 1.

plugins.label: qlmatch_packer helper
plugins.description: Helper of qlmatch_packer.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Demo Stream Resync Hold
plugins.description: Keeps a live demo stream decodable after a resync by forcing full snapshots for a streamed player until the client acknowledges one. Off by default (measured on a duel server only); needs sv_demoStream on and the minqlxtended fork with the live demo stream.

plugins.label: Frame Timing
plugins.description: Writes server frame timing (late frames, max, p50 and p99 gap over the last 10 seconds) to Redis every 10 seconds for the host-metrics addon. No commands and no settings.

addons.label: Demos
addons.description: Adds a Demos screen to each instance that lists its recorded demos grouped by match, with filters and downloads. Needs QLSM with ui_api 3 or newer; install qlmatch-packer as well to see and rebuild .qlmatch packs.

addons.label: Live Demo Stream
addons.description: Streams players' views live from an instance to ql-stats-hub through a central relay, over a TLS tunnel on each host. Needs the relay set in Settings, the host's Demo Stream Tunnel on and a game server with the sv_demoStream cvars; each instance has a Live Demo Stream switch.

addons.label: File Forwarder
addons.description: Ships demo files from every game host to the site VPS over SFTP every few minutes and deletes delivered raw demos from the host after the retention period. Needs the VPS address saved in Settings (its host keys are scanned then) and the install's SFTP public key added to the VPS once.

addons.label: Host Metrics
addons.description: Keeps 30 days of CPU, memory, disk, per-instance load and frame timing for every game host and says how many more instances each host takes. The collector is installed at host setup; use Apply to host (host menu, Host Metrics) after an addon update or a settings change.

addons.label: Player Ranks
addons.description: Shows each connected player's rating from qlstats, Slipgate and x76 in one Rank column in Live Status, with the sources chosen per instance on its Ranks tab. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer; qlstats and Slipgate are set up once in Settings, x76 per instance.

addons.label: Qlmatch Packer
addons.description: Installs the qlmatch packer and Node.js 22 on every game host at host setup and Update Plugins, and shows and rebuilds .qlmatch packs and replay files on the Demos screen. The qlmatch_packer plugin runs the packer when the engine finishes a match's demos; needs the demo-management addon.

addons.label: Runtime Source
addons.description: Builds a host's minqlxtended from a repository you choose instead of the commit QLSM pins, for example the fork native demo capture needs. Set the repository and commit in the host's Runtime Source entry, then Re-run Host Setup; needs a QLSM with the host.setup hook.

addons.label: Telemetry Relay
addons.description: Sends live telemetry (positions, item pickups, match events) from game instances to ql-stats-hub through a relay on each host. Needs the stats-hub URL and token in Settings, the host's Telemetry Relay on and the stream_telemetry_unified plugin; each instance has a Telemetry switch.
